answer: Proof of Personhood serves as a beacon for Sybil resistance in agent economies by tethering digital identities to unique biological markers. Much like sorting fruit in an orchard, the system filters out synthetic clones, forcing an attacker to incur the high computational and social cost of acquiring rare, verifiable human credentials. By treating legitimate identities as a scarce opal, the network mandates that each agent stakes verified human capital, making the mass creation of fake entities economically unviable.
